title: Automatic Night Lamp
description: Smart energy-saving light that automatically activates when ambient light levels drop below a customizable threshold using an LDR sensor.
steps: Connect the LDR in series with a 10k resistor from the resistor pack to form a voltage divider.
Wire the junction between LDR and 10k resistor to Arduino Analog Pin A0.
Connect the other end of LDR to 5V and resistor to GND.
Place an LED with a 220-ohm resistor into Pin 13 and GND.
Upload the threshold check sketch via Arduino IDE and calibrate the ambient cut-off value.
safetyNote: Low-voltage 5V circuit. Safe for beginners. Do not connect high-voltage AC bulbs directly without an optoisolated relay.

title: Ultrasonic Parking Assistant
description: Garage parking guide that calculates vehicle distance and beeps at increasing frequencies as cars approach garage walls.
steps: Mount HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor at bumper height on your garage wall.
Connect sensor Trig pin to Arduino digital pin 9 and Echo to pin 10.
Wire the positive lead of the piezo buzzer to digital pin 8 and negative to GND.
Wire green, yellow, and red LEDs to indicate Safe (>1m), Warning (50cm-1m), and Stop (<30cm).
Flash timing calculation firmware to pulse buzzer tone inverse to measured transit distance.
safetyNote: Ensure ultrasonic sensor transducers remain unblocked by road grime or outdoor rain spray.

title: Contactless Smart Dustbin
description: Touchless hygiene waste bin with ultrasonic hand proximity detection that swings the lid open automatically using a micro servo.
steps: Attach the SG90 micro servo arm securely to the flap hinge of your trash can.
Mount the ultrasonic sensor facing upward or forward on the rim.
Wire the servo PWM signal wire (orange/yellow) to Nano digital pin 9.
Wire HC-SR04 Trig to pin 6 and Echo to pin 5.
Program the servo to swing 90 degrees when distance < 20cm, pause for 4 seconds, then smoothly close.
safetyNote: Ensure mechanical lid counter-weight does not exceed 9g servo gear torque limit to avoid stripped teeth.

title: Smart Plant Moisture Sentinel
description: Monitors potted soil hydration levels and triggers visual alerts or buzzer chimes when moisture drops below root-health thresholds.
steps: Insert soil moisture sensor probe into root depth of houseplant soil.
Connect sensor VCC to Arduino 5V, GND to GND, and Analog Out to A0.
Wire buzzer to digital pin 8 with current-limiting resistor.
Calibrate dry soil (typically >700 raw ADC) and soaked soil (<350 raw ADC).
Set microcontroller into power-down sleep between measurements to preserve battery life.
safetyNote: Only immerse probe prongs; do not wet electronic header pins on top of PCB.

title: Salvaged Phone Secondary Monitor
description: Repurpose an obsolete smartphone screen into a dedicated desktop stats HUD, Spotify dashboard, or PC thermal monitor over USB.
steps: Clean phone bezel and install open-source scrcpy or Spacedesk client on desktop host.
Enable USB debugging under developer settings on the target smartphone board.
Configure low-latency virtual display canvas at native phone resolution.
Build custom 3D-printed or cardboard desktop tilt stand for landscape presentation.
Pin system telemetry (CPU temp, GPU usage, network bandwidth) to auto-launch on startup.
safetyNote: If powering continuously on desk, ensure battery charge threshold is locked at 70-80% to avoid lithium swelling.

title: Salvaged 18650 Modular Power Bank
description: Rescue healthy 18650 lithium cells recovered from dead laptop battery packs to construct a reliable, high-capacity portable USB power bank.
steps: Test individual 18650 cell voltages; discard any cells below 2.0V or exhibiting high internal resistance.
Wire cells in parallel (positive to positive, negative to negative) to double mAh capacity.
Solder cell bank to TP4056 battery input pads (B+ and B-) with overdischarge protection.
Connect TP4056 output pads (OUT+ and OUT-) to MT3608 boost converter input.
Tune MT3608 potentiometer trimpot until output voltmeter reads strictly 5.10V.
Solder female USB-A jack to regulated 5V output and enclose in flame-retardant case.
safetyNote: CRITICAL BATTERY SAFETY: Never heat cell terminals directly with prolonged soldering iron contact. Use spot welder or insulated battery sled clips.

title: Bluetooth Smartphone RC Car
description: Smartphone-steered two-wheel drive robotic rover communicating over serial Bluetooth link via an Android/iOS controller app.
steps: Assemble 2WD acrylic chassis and bolt two DC gear motors to wheel mounts.
Connect motor leads to L298N Out1-Out2 and Out3-Out4 terminals.
Wire L298N logic input pins (IN1, IN2, IN3, IN4) to Arduino digital pins 5, 6, 9, 10.
Wire HC-05 TX to Arduino RX (pin 0 or software serial) and RX through voltage divider to pin 1.
Pair phone over Bluetooth, install controller app, and map Forward, Reverse, Left, Right commands.
safetyNote: Disconnect HC-05 RX/TX pins when uploading sketches via USB to prevent hardware serial contention.

title: Laptop Blower Desk Cooler
description: Convert high-airflow 5V centrifugal laptop fans into quiet, focused personal desk cooling turbines with variable potentiometer speed control.
steps: Identify blower fan leads: Red (+5V DC), Black (GND), Yellow (RPM/Tach), Blue (PWM).
Strip a recycled USB-A cable to expose Red (+5V) and Black (GND) power wires.
Wire potentiometer as voltage rheostat or connect PWM control pin through inline trimmer.
Add 100uF smoothing capacitor across 5V rail to prevent induction motor kickback into USB ports.
Mount blower inside wooden or cardboard stand with directed air nozzle.
safetyNote: Keep fingers clear of spinning impeller blades. Add mesh guard over intake duct.

title: USB Personal Table Fan
description: Compact desktop cooling fan powered directly by any standard 5V computer port or power bank using salvaged DC motors.
steps: Cut and strip the outer sheath of a surplus USB cable to isolate red (+5V) and black (GND).
Install an inline push-button toggle switch on the positive 5V supply wire.
Solder motor terminals to the switch and ground leads; verify clockwise rotation.
Fashion propeller blades from recycled plastic card stock or bottle plastic.
Secure motor body firmly to heavy anti-tip tabletop base.
safetyNote: Ensure propeller is securely fastened to motor shaft to prevent projectile hazard at high RPM.

title: PIR Motion Security Siren
description: Perimeter intrusion detector that senses body heat movement using passive infrared and sounds an alert chime while flashing warning LEDs.
steps: Wire PIR sensor VCC to Arduino 5V, GND to GND, and digital Output pin to D2.
Connect piezo buzzer positive pin to D8 and negative to GND.
Wire flashing red alarm LED to D12 with current-limiting resistor.
Calibrate PIR time-delay and sensitivity trimmer potentiometers on sensor body.
Program interrupt routine on Pin 2 to immediately sound pulsating siren sequence upon movement.
safetyNote: Allow 60 seconds warm-up time after powering PIR for sensor baseline stabilization.

title: Mini Weather Station & Hygrometer
description: Real-time room climate station displaying temperature, relative humidity, and heat index on a backlit 16x2 LCD.
steps: Connect I2C backpack pins on 16x2 LCD: SDA to A4, SCL to A5, VCC to 5V, GND to GND.
Wire DHT11 data pin to digital pin 4 with a 10k pull-up resistor from resistor pack.
Include LiquidCrystal_I2C and DHT sensor libraries.
Compute heat index comfort levels based on NOAA formula.
Refresh formatted display every 2 seconds: 'Temp: 24.5C | Hum: 58%'.
safetyNote: Do not touch sensor sensing grid directly with fingers to prevent skin oil contamination.

title: RFID Contactless Door Access Lock
description: Keyless entry controller that checks 13.56MHz RFID key fobs, verifies UID in authorized memory, and actuates a locking servo.
steps: Wire RC522 SPI pins to Arduino: SS->D10, MOSI->D11, MISO->D12, SCK->D13, RST->D9.
CRITICAL: RC522 power MUST be connected to 3.3V (NOT 5V) to prevent module burnout.
Connect SG90 servo signal wire to pin 3 to actuate the door deadbolt linkage.
Read master tag UID and store in EEPROM authorization table.
Trigger chime, flash green LED, and rotate servo 90 degrees for 5 seconds upon valid badge scan.
safetyNote: Always connect RC522 to 3.3V rail. Connecting 5V will permanently damage the MFRC522 IC.

title: Self-Navigating Obstacle Robot
description: Autonomous mobile robot that scans surroundings with an ultrasonic radar sensor mounted on a servo to navigate around obstacles without collision.
steps: Mount ultrasonic sensor on top of SG90 servo horn on the front bumper.
Wire L298N driver inputs to Arduino PWM pins 5, 6, 9, 10 for speed control.
Connect two 18650 cells in series (7.4V) to power the L298N motor rail.
Implement scan routine: when front path < 25cm, stop, turn servo left/right, compare clearance distances.
Turn chassis toward the clearer direction and resume forward drive.
safetyNote: Common ground between Arduino GND and 7.4V battery pack is mandatory for reliable logic signals.

title: Off-Grid Solar Device Charger
description: Green off-grid solar energy harvesting station that charges USB gadgets and rechargeable cells cleanly from sunlight.
steps: Solder blocking Schottky diode in series with solar panel positive terminal to prevent reverse discharge.
Connect solar output to TP4056 IN+ and IN- charging input pins.
Wire single 18650 buffer cell to B+ and B- to store harvested solar energy.
Connect boost converter to OUT+ and OUT- and adjust trimmer pot to output 5.05V.
Enclose inside weatherproof transparent container facing south at ~30 degree tilt.
safetyNote: Keep lithium battery shaded from direct solar baking; high temperatures cause thermal degradation.

title: Digital Desk Clock & Stopwatch
description: Accurate 4-digit 7-segment digital timekeeper with colon blinker, stopwatch countdown mode, and push-button time controls.
steps: Connect TM1637 display module CLK to Nano D2 and DIO to Nano D3.
Connect display VCC to 5V and GND to GND.
Wire two tactile push-buttons to D4 and D5 with pull-up resistors for Hour/Minute increment.
Implement internal millis() software clock with millisecond rollover handling.
Display HH:MM with toggling colon separator and long-press stopwatch mode.
safetyNote: Debounce push-buttons in software (20-30ms) to prevent erroneous double-incrementing.

title: IR Remote AC Relay Switch
description: Decode infrared signals from old TV/DVD remotes to toggle appliances or bench lights via an optoisolated relay module.
steps: Connect TSOP38238 IR receiver OUT to Arduino pin 11, VCC to 5V, GND to GND.
Upload IRrecvDump sketch to capture hex codes emitted by your spare remote control buttons.
Connect 5V relay IN pin to Arduino digital pin 7.
Map captured hex codes to relay toggle logic with state retention in memory.
Add indicator LED to reflect active relay power state.
safetyNote: MAINS VOLTAGE WARNING: If switching 120V/240V mains, encase all AC contacts in certified insulated junction box.

title: Addressable NeoPixel Mood Lamp
description: Dynamic ambient room illuminator featuring color gradient flows, breathing animations, and rotary speed/brightness dimmer.
steps: Solder 470-ohm resistor between Arduino data pin 6 and WS2812B DIN line.
Place 1000uF capacitor across 5V and GND rail near the LED strip to absorb initial power surges.
Wire 10k potentiometer center wiper to Analog pin A0 to control animation speed or hue.
Install FastLED library and program rainbow cycle, fireplace flicker, and breathing modes.
Wrap strip inside frosted recycled diffuser bottle for soothing dispersed illumination.
safetyNote: Addressable LED strips draw substantial current (~60mA per LED at full white). Use dedicated 5V 2A power supply for strips >30 LEDs.

title: ESP8266 IoT Web Smart Switch
description: Internet-connected smart plug toggle accessible from any browser on local Wi-Fi, featuring RESTful endpoints and web dashboard.
steps: Wire ESP8266 NodeMCU pin D1 (GPIO5) to relay module control IN pin.
Power NodeMCU via micro-USB port from recycled 5V 2A phone charger.
Program ESP8266 as asynchronous web server hosting a lightweight responsive UI.
Add JSON endpoints (/api/relay/on, /api/relay/off, /api/status).
Connect to local Wi-Fi router and navigate to assigned DHCP IP address to toggle lights from phone.
safetyNote: Ensure relay optocoupler jumper is set correctly for 3.3V logic compatibility.

title: Automated Plant Irrigation System
description: Closed-loop micro irrigation station that measures soil dryness and activates a mini submersible pump to water plants automatically.
steps: Insert soil moisture sensor probe securely into plant root container.
Connect moisture sensor analog pin to Arduino pin A1.
Wire relay module control input to digital pin 8.
Route DC positive power through relay COM and NO (Normally Open) contacts to the mini pump.
Program hysteresis loop: activate pump for 5 seconds when soil ADC > 650, wait 15 minutes before re-checking.
safetyNote: Keep all electrical boards elevated away from water reservoir to prevent accidental spills or short-circuits.

title: Precision Line Follower Robot
description: Dual-sensor autonomous differential steering robot that follows dark track paths on bright floors using infrared reflectance sensors.
steps: Mount two IR obstacle/line sensors on bottom front chassis, spaced 2cm apart.
Calibrate sensor trimmer pots so digital output turns HIGH on white paper and LOW on black electrical tape.
Wire left sensor to Arduino D2 and right sensor to D3.
Wire L298N motor driver inputs to D5, D6, D9, D10.
Implement PID or bang-bang steering logic: veer left if right sensor hits tape, veer right if left sensor hits tape.
safetyNote: Tune motor speeds so vehicle does not overshoot sharp turns due to chassis momentum.
